question: A sector of radius 14 cm has an area of 154 cm². Find the angle of the sector.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Area of a full circle = πr² = (22 ÷ 7) × 14 × 14 = 616 cm².

The given area of the sector is 154 cm².

Ratio of the sector area to the full circle area = 154 ÷ 616 = 1 ÷ 4.

Since the area is proportional to the central angle, the angle must be 1/4 of a full circle (360°).

⇒ Sector angle = 360° × (1 ÷ 4) = 90°.

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the sector (r) = 14 cm

Area of the sector = 154 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area of sector = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr²

**Calculations:**

⇒ 154 = (θ ÷ 360°) × (22 ÷ 7) × 14 × 14

⇒ 154 = (θ ÷ 360°) × 22 × 2 × 14

⇒ 154 = (θ ÷ 360°) × 616

⇒ θ ÷ 360° = 154 ÷ 616

⇒ θ ÷ 360° = 1 ÷ 4

⇒ θ = 360° × (1 ÷ 4)

⇒ θ = 90°

**∴ The correct answer is 90°.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Area of a Sector

The area of a sector of a circle with radius r and central angle θ is given by the formula: Area = (θ ÷ 360°) × πr².

Length of an Arc

The length of the boundary arc of the sector is proportional to the central angle and is calculated as: Arc Length (l) = (θ ÷ 360°) × 2πr.

Perimeter of a Sector

The total perimeter of a sector includes the curved arc length and the two straight radii. Formula: Perimeter = l + 2r.
